svg.text: REGISTER ARRAY (reset value of all registers = 0 except TANK_POS = spawn point, HEALTH = 20 / 20)
Fig 5 - Sprite & HUD Register File (12 x 32-bit write-only MMIO registers)

Each register: comparator on d_addr[7:2] AND wr_en_spr -> select of a hold mux -> FF. Same row structure repeated 12 times; outputs run continuously to the Sprite Engine, Health HUD and Collision Engine.
Bullet slot fields: x,y are pixel coordinates (10 bits cover 640); act = bullet alive; big = special 5-damage bullet.
Tank angle index selects one of 16 rotated sprites in the Sprite Engine ROM and the cos/sin LUT row in C.
Software writes a bullet by sw to its BULLET_REG_n; act=0 removes it (collision / wall-lifetime / cancel).
